diagnostics.message: The run finished with an unresolved verifier failure.
diagnostics.remediation: Resolve the failure or explicitly stop without claiming completion.

diagnostics.message: A changed source file begins or ends with an isolated markdown fence boundary.
diagnostics.remediation: Strip isolated leading or trailing fence boundary lines before writing source files, then re-verify that the file compiles.

notes.EAL001: Process-level: needs only verifier events and harness-observed workspace changes. Fully language-agnostic.
notes.EAL002: Process-level: needs an observable compile/test result and a finish event. Fully language-agnostic.
notes.EAL003: Ecosystem-dependent: needs a known lockfile policy (package.json/package-lock, pyproject/uv.lock). No common shell/C convention, so the policy is unknown there and the rule abstains. No manifest exists in algorithm/terminal shapes.
notes.EAL004: Path-classification of production vs. test changes is language-agnostic, but the observable test-suite scope fact is rarely available outside repository tasks.
notes.EAL005: Ecosystem-dependent: generated/vendored ownership must be confirmed (dist/, *.min.js, lockstep outputs); unknown ownership abstains. Mechanism only occurs in repository tasks.
notes.EAL006: Claim-vs-baseline audit over harness facts; language-agnostic. Terminal tasks usually have no base revision to reproduce against, so it abstains.
notes.EAL007: Patch-workflow specific: needs structured patch events plus a harness-bound base revision. Language-agnostic where a patch workflow exists; the mechanism does not occur in non-patch shapes.
notes.EAL008: File-content-dependent but language-agnostic: an isolated markdown fence boundary is contamination in any non-markdown file, including data fixtures. Abstains when written contents are not captured.
notes.EAL009: Signature-list dependent: the dependency-failure pattern covers `cannot find module` / `ModuleNotFoundError` / `no module named` / `unresolved import` (src/agentic_lint/rules.py). Python/JS/Java-style import errors match; shell `command not found` and C missing headers do not, so those cells abstain or miss.
notes.EAL010: Process-level: identical-command repetition over the normalized trace. Fully language-agnostic; needs only the harness `trace_complete` assertion.
notes.EAL011: Process-level: harness-extracted summary claim vs. observable verifier taxonomy. Fully language-agnostic; abstains without an extracted summary.
notes.EAL012: Harness-convention dependent, not language-dependent: applies anywhere the harness emits an ignore policy and context-acquisition events; abstains everywhere it does not (most harnesses today).

abstains_when: no successful verifier event is available
rules.rationale: A passing result describes an older patch, not the submitted patch.
rules.remediation: Run the relevant verifier again after the final source change.
rules.summary: Detect edits made after the final passing verifier.
rules.title: Dirty after verification

abstains_when: no verifier outcome is available
completion after the failure is not observable
applicability_requires: an observable compile or test result
rules.rationale: A terminal failure is direct evidence that the final patch is not verified.
rules.remediation: Resolve the failure or explicitly stop without claiming completion.
rules.summary: Detect completion after the last compile/test result failed.
rules.title: Unresolved failure at finish

abstains_when: lockfile policy is unknown
the manifest diff cannot be classified
rules.rationale: Manifest/lockfile drift can make evaluation installs non-reproducible.
rules.remediation: Regenerate and include the repository's lockfile, or revert the manifest change.
rules.summary: Detect common dependency manifests changed alone.
rules.title: Manifest changed without lockfile

abstains_when: no successful test is observable
suite scope or targets are unavailable
applicability_requires: production and newly added test changes
rules.rationale: A new test can pass while existing behavior regresses elsewhere.
rules.remediation: Run the relevant existing suite in addition to the new regression test.
rules.summary: Detect production changes checked only by a newly added targeted test.
rules.title: Only a new test was run

abstains_when: generated or vendored ownership is unknown
generator-event capture is incomplete
rules.rationale: Hand-edited generated artifacts commonly drift from their source of truth.
rules.remediation: Change the source and run the generator; record generated paths in the generation event.
rules.summary: Detect generated-looking outputs edited without a generator event.
rules.title: Generated file changed without regeneration

abstains_when: claim identity fields are missing
baseline-event capture is incomplete
rules.rationale: Without a base-revision reproduction, the patch may have caused the failure.
rules.remediation: Run the same verifier against the untouched baseline and record it as baseline_verification.
rules.summary: Detect pre-existing failure claims without baseline evidence.
rules.title: Unsupported pre-existing-failure claim

abstains_when: patch-event capture is incomplete
the workspace base revision is not bound by the harness
rules.rationale: Patches generated without repository context often fail to apply; an exact-base preflight separates applicability errors from semantic errors before expensive evaluation.
rules.remediation: Run an applicability check such as git apply --check against the bound base revision, recorded as a patch_preflight event, before applying the patch.
rules.summary: Detect failed patch applications not preceded by an exact-base applicability check.
rules.title: Patch applied without applicability preflight

abstains_when: written file contents are not observable
contents for some changed source files were not captured
rules.rationale: Extraction artifacts such as stray triple-backtick boundary lines invalidate otherwise correct code at compile time.
rules.remediation: Strip isolated leading or trailing fence boundary lines before writing source files, then re-verify that the file compiles.
rules.summary: Detect isolated fence boundary lines bordering changed non-markdown source files.
rules.title: Markdown fence contaminated a source file

abstains_when: no verifier outcome is available
the first failing verifier has no observable failure output
run failure attribution is not recorded by the harness
applicability_requires: an observable failing verifier with failure output
a failing require/import that resolves from within the repository's module-resolution root
rules.rationale: A missing-module failure usually reflects environment setup rather than the patch; attributing it to the patch corrupts failure analysis. The rule is scoped to failures whose failing require/import originates within the repository's module-resolution root: a resolution failure raised from a scratch script outside that root (for example a /tmp helper) is a path-boundary artifact, not a dependency-setup failure, and is cleared rather than fired.
rules.remediation: Install or restore the missing dependency and rerun the verifier, or reclassify the failure as environment setup rather than patch behavior.
rules.summary: Detect first-failure dependency-resolution errors blamed on the patch without a later install step.
rules.title: Dependency setup failure attributed to the patch

abstains_when: trace ordering and completeness are not established by the harness
failure signatures for the repeated command are not observable
applicability_requires: observable command outcomes and failure signatures
rules.rationale: Re-running an unchanged failing command yields no new information and indicates a stalled loop.
rules.remediation: Change an input before retrying: edit the code, adjust the command, or gather different diagnostics.
rules.summary: Detect four or more consecutive identical commands with identical failures and no intervening edit.
rules.title: Repeated identical failing command

abstains_when: no harness-extracted final summary is available
a success claim does not map to the observable verifier taxonomy
applicability_requires: success claims that map to the verifier taxonomy
rules.rationale: A summary claiming passing tests or builds while the last observable verifier of that kind failed or never ran misreports the run state. Unlike EAL002, this is a claim-versus-evidence mismatch, not an unresolved failure at completion.
rules.remediation: Re-run the claimed verifier after the final change and make the summary match the recorded outcome.
rules.summary: Detect final-summary success claims the last matching verifier does not support.
rules.title: Unverified final success claim

abstains_when: no harness-supplied ignore policy is available
context-acquisition capture is incomplete
applicability_requires: a harness-supplied ignore policy with patterns
rules.rationale: Files excluded by a declared ignore policy must not become readable model context; silent inclusion violates the declared context contract.
rules.remediation: Remove ignored paths from context acquisition or change the ignore policy; write-only access remains permitted.
rules.summary: Detect context reads of paths matched by the harness-supplied ignore policy.
rules.title: Ignored file entered model context

sample_cards.excerpt: Recurrence confirmed across two model/provider paths. The reusable mechanism is not simply ‘bad patch’: the pipeline treated patch-shaped text as applicable. Keep syntax validation separate from semantic grading; a candidate rule should run a parser plus `git apply --check` on t…
sample_cards.title: Malformed unified diff passed weak extraction preflight

sample_cards.excerpt: Three model families recur on the same issue-only failure surface. This is primarily a harness/context mechanism: predictions were generated without checkout context and never passed applicability preflight. Do not interpret these rows as test failures or as a voice-perturbation…
sample_cards.title: Issue-only patch guessed repository context and failed to apply

sample_cards.excerpt: Multiple tasks reproduce an extractor-boundary failure, and aggregate re-evaluation changes the headline score by seven points. Normalize isolated fence boundary lines before compilation, preserve raw output, and re-score cached generations whenever extractor logic changes.
sample_cards.title: Correct raw code was invalidated by a stray markdown fence boundary

sample_cards.excerpt: Two independent hard-identifier tasks fail at symbol grounding while behavior remains semantically close. The executable check is presence of the required parsed symbol; the systems intervention is a non-speech anchor channel for exact identifiers.
sample_cards.title: ASR-corrupted opaque identifier lacked an authoritative code anchor

sample_cards.excerpt: The same module-scope contract leakage category appears across distinct backbones. A language-aware detector can flag top-level expressions that load names bound only as function parameters; keep it experimental until tested against framework-injected globals.
sample_cards.title: Input-contract checks leaked into module top level
